airbyte_sync_failed_trigger.description: Runs when an Airbyte sync job fails, of every connection or the one you choose, after Airbyte's own retries. Jobs that failed before the workflow was turned on don't start it.

parameters.description: Only jobs of this connection. Leave blank for every connection.
parameters.name: airbyte_connection_id

parameters.description: Only jobs in this workspace. Leave blank for every workspace.
parameters.name: workspace_id

airbyte_sync_succeeded_trigger.description: Runs when an Airbyte sync job succeeds, of every connection or the one you choose, with the rows it synced. Jobs that succeeded before the workflow was turned on don't start it.

parameters.description: Only jobs of this connection. Leave blank for every connection.
parameters.name: airbyte_connection_id

parameters.description: Only jobs in this workspace. Leave blank for every workspace.
parameters.name: workspace_id
